audio.strategy: One AudioContext and one stereo AudioWorklet integrate two Piano layers, two Organ layers, and three Synth layers through six inherited effect chains and one shared master/limiter destination. Organ and Synth use original live synthesis, not recordings or vendor DSP. Piano Grand/Upright/Electric retain explicitly labeled synthesis fallbacks because no source recordings were supplied.

sampleLibrary.loader: Injectable fetch/decode, validates provenance, selects nearest root and interpolates velocity layers when authorized recorded assets exist. No files are fetched with the empty supplied manifest.

audio.signalPath: Piano A/B and Synth A/B/C each have an independent Mod1 -> Mod2 -> Delay -> Amp/EQ -> Compressor -> Reverb chain, then shared rotary when routed and layer level. Organ A/B are weighted by their individual levels and summed before one shared Organ chain and shared rotary. All six chain outputs enter the inherited smoothed master gain, tanh limiter and single stereo worklet output connected to one AudioContext destination.
audio.stealing: Inherited deterministic released, sustained, oldest-held priority within each layer; source-instance ownership retained.
audio.status: Idle, loading, context ready or error/retry. Library status separately remains fallback when recordings are absent or fail. OLED reports recordings unavailable; selected recorded-type LED flashes. The app never reports the primary recorded library ready when fallback is active.

effects.implementation: Original deterministic DSP, shared unchanged between browser AudioWorklet and rendered signal tests. Approximation of the documented effect families, not vendor DSP.
effects.types: Every type in inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.effects.json is selectable. EQ-only and To Rotary share their local EQ processing; To Rotary additionally uses the shared downstream rotor.
effects.rotary: One shared smoothly accelerating horn/bass rotor clock; six stereo history pairs for the six chains. Organ routes via system.organRotary; Piano and Synth use To Rotary. Continuous speed and stop use the same rotor.
effects.ramps: Inherited effect parameter/bypass, master and Piano/Synth chain levels use 10ms smoothing; Piano effect type transitions retain 20ms crossfades. ExtraDSP voice/zone/arp gain uses 3ms smoothing. Rotary speed approaches its target over approximately 650ms. Organ layer levels are applied before the shared chain; no per-organ-layer level smoothing is implemented.
effects.groupGlobal: Piano and Synth grouping copies settings within each section. Delay/Compressor/Reverb global edits all six chains. Organ A/B share one effect chain.

notes: No bundled recordings: the inherited Grand/Upright/Electric recorded-library hard gate remains unmet. Synthesized fallback labels and empty recorded provenance are retained.
Organ and Synth are original approximations of the documented families, not vendor DSP or sampled instruments. B3 Bass and Pipe 2 reuse their documented parent engines.

Piano notes retain the inherited 12-second retirement cap. Organ/Synth voices continue while held; release, Panic and disposal clean up owned voices. Arp hold intentionally retains notes until released by hold-off, voice replacement or Panic.
Organ A/B levels precede their shared effects to retain individual layer balance; this is an approximation of the nominal post-effect level order.
Phase 1 BrowserAudio and Phase 2 LayeredPianoEngine remain regression fixtures. Production App defaults to SystemEngine, which extends the inherited engine and shares LayerAudio.
Production DSP is tested directly with deterministic rendered Float32Arrays. Phase 3 browser OfflineAudioContext/worklet evidence has not completed; no browser success is claimed.
Soft/sostenuto pedal behavior is not implemented. Piano string resonance remains an additive simulation.

hardware.presentationState: All 155 inherited IDs and section geometry are retained. systemBinding and the inherited panelBinding use canonical instrument/system state; only the eight explicit unsupportedControls entries retain presentation-only behavior. Accessible SystemDetails and PianoDetails disclosures expose detailed parameters. See evidence/stage3-control-audit.json and src/system-ui.test.tsx.
hardware.geometryPrecedence: Visual spec v1.4 and photo override the obsolete fractions in the phase prompt.
hardware.narrowInspection: Full instrument overview at 94% width; Inspect surface enlarges to 1400px in an independently scrollable viewport.

boundaries.audio: LayerAudioBoundary, AudioContext and AudioWorkletNode factories, injectable sample loader. Production InstrumentDSP is also invoked directly for deterministic rendered tests. Message barriers synchronize browser offline rendering.
boundaries.midi: RequestMidi and MidiAccess interfaces injected into InputController.
boundaries.events: Window target injected into InputController.attach; pure input methods available for device-free tests.
boundaries.timing: DSP sample clock; injected clock for tap tempo; no application timers.
boundaries.storage: Injected StorageBoundary getItem/setItem; production localStorage key stage4-programs-v1 persists 32 regular programs and eight auto-storing Live slots. Read/write errors are reported and edits remain in memory.
